activities.activity: Review SOW, SWMS, drawings, geotechnical report and specification
criteria: Contract scope, exclusions (rock / hard digging, latent conditions, services location, potholing, retaining walls, swales, dewatering, sediment control) and clarifications confirmed in writing
Current IFC revision of civil and structural drawings confirmed on Procore
Fill material specification, layer thickness, compaction standard, moisture range and test frequency extracted from geotechnical report and CSP
Founding requirements (bearing, material, inspection) extracted from structural general notes
Grid lines, datum and control marks received from CDI in writing and checked against the feature survey
Extent of clearing, strip, cut, fill, batters and building platforms set out; batter and platform RLs taken from IFC drawings
Pre-start dated photo record of the whole site, adjoining surfaces and access roads
Written clearance from CDI for each area before any ground is broken; location, potholing and protection of services is excluded from KBS scope
Known services marked on the ground; exclusion zones and hand-dig / spotter requirements briefed at pre-start
Any unidentified service: stop, isolate, notify CDI immediately
Trees to be retained identified and protected by others; KBS plant kept outside protection zones
Dust suppression: water cart available during KBS working hours; fill point confirmed by CDI
Cut to formation levels and batters shown
Formation within tolerance before proof roll
Excavated material stockpiled for reuse only where the geotech report allows; surplus removed with dockets
Rock or hard digging is excluded - photograph, measure and notify CDI in writing the same day before proceeding
Exposed subgrade proof rolled with roller
No visible deflection, heave or rutting; soft or wet areas excavated and replaced with approved fill to Engineer direction
Subgrade moisture conditioned and compacted before fill
HOLD POINT - no fill placed on unapproved subgrade
Imported engineered fill from nominated source tested before delivery: grading, plasticity, CBR, free of organics, contaminants and oversize
Site fill only where the geotechnical report permits and tested to the same standard
Source and test results submitted to CDI / geotech for approval before bulk delivery; no change of source without re-approval
Fill placed in horizontal layers not exceeding typically 200-300 mm loose thickness, moisture conditioned to spec.
Fill over service trenches (excavated and initially backfilled by others) only after as-constructed received and initial backfill inspected
Fill kept free of ponding; rain-affected layers scarified, dried and recompacted
NATA-accredited field density testing at frequency - typically 1 test per 500 m2 per layer or per 250 m3, minimum 2 per layer
Acceptance: typically minimum 95% standard MDD general fill; 98% under footings / slabs; 100% within top 300 mm of pavement subgrade
Failed tests: layer reworked and retested; retest recorded beneath the failed test on the register, no layer covered until passed
Results to CDI within 2 business days of receipt
Finished formation and pavement subgrade levels surveyed: within tolerance
Final proof roll witnessed; surface trimmed and lightly compacted; free of loose material
Platform protected from traffic and weather until following trade takes over; damage before handover made good by KBS
HOLD POINT - handover to concrete works (ITP-002) and to others

activities.activity: Detailed excavation - footings, pits, lift pit, sumps
criteria: Excavated to line, level and dimension
Sides stable or battered per SWMS; excavations left open protected with barriers and edge protection, never left open overnight unprotected
Base clean, dry and free of loose material; over-excavation made good with approved fill or concrete per Engineer direction
Dewatering after detailed excavation or rain is excluded - notify CDI
Founding material at every pad, strip and pit inspected by CDI engineer and confirmed as the material and bearing
Unsuitable founding: stop, notify CDI in writing, Engineer direction obtained (deepen, replace with engineered fill or concrete)
HOLD POINT - no blinding, membrane, formwork or reinforcement until released; 24 h notice given to CDI and Engineer
Stockpiles in locations agreed with CDI, kept tidy, not against structures or over services
All spoil and waste removed to a licensed facility; every docket retained and logged (classification per facility requirements)
Contaminated or unexpected material: stop, isolate, notify CDI - disposal by direction
Geotechnical engineer's compliance / certification report covering subgrade approvals, fill source, layer records and all test results
All test registers, proof roll and founding records, disposal dockets and NCRs closed and issued to CDI
Site left tidy; tracks reinstated; this ITP signed and issued

closing: Works completed and testing completed in line with this ITP except as noted above.
